## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive; Energy and Utilities are the only sector-level outperformers while Technology and Financials show broad weakness (many large caps BELOW TREND). Leadership concentration: Moderate (Top 5 performers span 3 sectors), supporting a neutral, wait-for-confirmation stance.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy leads: OXY (1W: +7.32% | 1M: +23.11%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +3.62% | 1M: +6.96%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +3.25% | 1M: +1.03%) ABOVE TREND. Materials showing pockets of strength via DOW (1W: +10.04% | 1M: +8.98%) ABOVE TREND and APD (1W: +5.80% | 1M: -1.76%) RECOVERY. Technology momentum names showing short-term bounces: AMAT (1W: +5.17% | 1M: +0.61%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +6.46% | 1M: -9.64%) RECOVERY.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Financials lag: WFC (1W: -7.86% | 1M: -16.69%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -2.09% | 1M: -8.81%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary and Industrials weak: TSLA (1W: -1.39% | 1M: -8.66%) BELOW TREND, BA (1W: -9.18% | 1M: -11.16%) BELOW TREND. Technology weakness is broad among mega-caps (AAPL, MSFT, META all BELOW TREND).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: DOW (1W: +10.04% | 1M: +8.98%) ABOVE TREND; OXY (1W: +7.32% | 1M: +23.11%) ABOVE TREND; LRCX (1W: +6.46% | 1M: -9.64%) RECOVERY; APD (1W: +5.80% | 1M: -1.76%) RECOVERY; INTC (1W: +5.41% | 1M: -5.22%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Moderate concentration (3 sectors in Top 5) — cyclicals (Energy/Materials) are prominent.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: GE (1W: -7.11% | 1M: -4.34%) BELOW TREND; TMO (1W: -7.40% | 1M: -11.83%) BELOW TREND; SYK (1W: -7.62% | 1M: -7.40%) BELOW TREND; WFC (1W: -7.86% | 1M: -16.69%) BELOW TREND; KHC (1W: -7.99% | 1M: -8.13%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Industrials/Healthcare/Financials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W movers: DOW (1W: +10.04% | 1M: +8.98%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +7.32% | 1M: +23.11%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +6.46% | 1M: -9.64%) RECOVERY. Note MAJOR divergence across big names: NVDA (1W: +1.37% | 1M: -5.15%) RECOVERY, GOOGL (1W: +1.33% | 1M: -2.72%) RECOVERY, AMZN (1W: -2.60% | 1M: +1.76%) CORRECTION — tactical noise, watch for trend break.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Technology mixed-to-weak: ADBE (1W: -12.09% | 1M: -3.05%) BELOW TREND, ACN (1W: -8.53% | 1M: -14.66%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: +5.17% | 1M: +0.61%) ABOVE TREND. Several semi names are RECOVERY (LRCX, ASML), but mega-cap techs are predominantly BELOW TREND — internal rotation within Tech with limited breadth.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials soft overall: WFC (1W: -7.86% | 1M: -16.69%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -2.09% | 1M: -8.81%) BELOW TREND. Visa/Mastercard also BELOW TREND: V (1W: -3.22% | 1M: -6.71%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: -4.66% | 1M: -7.34%) BELOW TREND — sector breadth weak and confirms neutral regime.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare weak-to-mixed: JNJ (1W: +0.47% | 1M: +0.81%) ABOVE TREND stands out, but names like TMO (1W: -7.40% | 1M: -11.83%) BELOW TREND and SYK (1W: -7.62% | 1M: -7.40%) BELOW TREND show pressure; expect selective behavior around defensive names.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor Value/Cyclical exposure within a neutral framework: emphasize Energy and select Materials (OXY, CVX, DOW) while reducing exposure to large-cap Tech names that remain BELOW TREND (AAPL, MSFT, META). Given the major divergence among megacaps, treat Tech strength as tactical not broad-based.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: XOM (1W: +3.25% | 1M: +1.03%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +3.62% | 1M: +6.96%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +10.04% | 1M: +8.98%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: ADBE (1W: -12.09% | 1M: -3.05%) BELOW TREND, WFC (1W: -7.86% | 1M: -16.69%) BELOW TREND, ACN (1W: -8.53% | 1M: -14.66%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (sector 1W: +2.38% | 1M: +7.50%) — multiple names ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Technology and Financials — sector-level weakness and multiple large-cap names BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
NVDA (1W: +1.37% | 1M: -5.15%) RECOVERY — watch a clear weekly close above recent resistance for trend confirmation. AAPL (1W: -2.85% | 1M: -9.21%) BELOW TREND — reclaiming the 1W range is needed to signal stabilization. XOM (1W: +3.25% | 1M: +1.03%) ABOVE TREND — hold for continuation if sector strength persists. WFC (1W: -7.86% | 1M: -16.69%) BELOW TREND — failure to stabilize would deepen Financials downside.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
INTU (+70): Intuit halts mgmt stock sales and boosts buybacks — INTU (1W: -8.56% | 1M: +10.08%) CORRECTION; news bullish but price under pressure (divergence). APD (+60): Wells Fargo upgrade on hydrogen/industrial catalysts — APD (1W: +5.80% | 1M: -1.76%) RECOVERY; sentiment confirming short-term accumulation. TSLA (+55): Musk terafab news — TSLA (1W: -1.39% | 1M: -8.66%) BELOW TREND; bullish headline but price not confirming (watch for follow-through).

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
GOOGL (-50): EU search probe headlines — GOOGL (1W: +1.33% | 1M: -2.72%) RECOVERY; news bearish but short-term price showing a bounce (divergence). ACN (-45): PT cut amid multiple compression — ACN (1W: -8.53% | 1M: -14.66%) BELOW TREND; sentiment and price aligned. MS (-45): withdrawal/credit flow headlines — MS (not in detailed timeframe list) flagged by news; monitor Financials given sector weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, favor Value/Cyclical style. XOM (1W: +3.25% | 1M: +1.03%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +3.62% | 1M: +6.96%) ABOVE TREND and DOW (1W: +10.04% | 1M: +8.98%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk is major divergence among large caps (NVDA, GOOGL, AMZN) and several bullish headlines (e.g., INTU) not yet translating into price confirmation.
